title.title: Create a Prime Contract
title.subtitle: Owner setup, dates, estimate SOV, and detailed scope

outro.title: Prime contract setup is ready for review
outro.subtitle: Verify every entry against the executed contract before saving

steps.caption: Start in Project Directory to verify the owner entity before contract entry.
Open the owner company and compare it with the signed agreement.
Verify the legal company name, status, and full address; correct missing or mismatched facts before continuing.
Confirm the owner invoice contact's name, billing email, job title, and Primary flag.
If no invoice contact is linked, add one from the company directory.
Create a billing contact when the correct person is not listed.
Enter the invoice contact's first name.
Enter the invoice contact's last name.
Use the billing email that should receive owner invoices.
Add the invoice contact's direct phone number.
Use a job title that identifies the billing responsibility.
Confirm the owner company is selected, then save only after every detail is verified.
With the owner record ready, open Create Prime Contract.
Enter the contract number exactly as shown in the agreement.
Use a clear contract title tied to the executed work.
Select the verified owner business entity.
Set Owner / Client to the company on the signed contract.
Set the contract status to its current lifecycle stage.
Use Approved only when the agreement is fully authorized.
Enter the retainage percentage required by the contract.

type.text: Owner agreement for the interior renovation, including general conditions, demolition, framing, drywall, finishes, closeout, and turnover.

steps.caption: Add a concise contract narrative that explains the overall work.
Attach the executed contract, proposal, exhibits, bonds, and insurance files.
Set the start date from the executed contract or notice to proceed.
Set completion from the contractual completion requirement.
Import the Schedule of Values from the approved estimate or proposal.
Choose the completed estimate workbook and let Alleato preview it.
Review selected rows, amounts, mappings, and warnings before import.
Import the selected estimate rows into the contract SOV.
Confirm the imported descriptions, amounts, and SOV total.

type.text: General conditions; demolition; framing; drywall; finishes; permits; closeout documents; and owner turnover.

steps.caption: Enter detailed inclusions from the contract scope and exhibits.

type.text: Owner-furnished equipment; loose furniture; specialty AV; utility fees; and work outside the executed contract exhibits.

steps.caption: Enter exclusions so responsibility is clear before billing starts.
Final check: owner, contact, dates, retainage, SOV, scope, and attachments.
